description: Use this when someone asks what their vet clinic's procedures cost or how long they take, or needs procedure ids to book one. Returns the clinic's procedures with id, name, price, duration and whether each is a vaccine, which only Veterical itself books. Not for an animal's treatment history.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

limit.description: Catalog rows per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50

name: list_procedures

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

procedures.description: Catalog procedures, most recently edited first. Descriptions, patient-linked treatments, diagnoses, notes, reminders and every other clinical field are excluded.

duration.description: Configured duration, or null when none was recorded

vaccine.description: A vaccine records a vaccination and its recall when booked, so book_appointment refuses it

title: List clinic procedures and prices
